text:
Samsung Electronics profit growth slows despite stellar chip sales By 0
SEOUL (Reuters) – Samsung Electronics Co Ltd ( 005930.KS ) posted its slowest quarterly revenue development in additional than a yr on Tuesday because the sluggish world smartphone market weighed on earnings, though the chip enterprise continued to carry out properly.
The emblem of Samsung Electronics is seen at its workplace constructing in Seoul, South Korea South Korea, October 11, 2017. Image taken on October 11, 2017. REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji
Working revenue for the world’s largest chipmaker and smartphone maker rose 5.7 % to 14.9 trillion received ($13.three billion) within the second quarter, Samsung stated in a regulatory submitting, in contrast with 14.eight trillion received it had estimated.
The Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) elements provider and smartphone rival stated working revenue from the cell enterprise sank 34 % from a yr in the past, and warned of stiffer competitors within the second half as a result of launch of latest fashions.
The South Korean tech large added nevertheless that demand for reminiscence chips, its largest earnings contributor by far, would stay robust within the second half due to the expansion of server information centres.
Income for the April-June interval fell four % to 58.5 trillion received, broadly consistent with Samsung’s earlier estimate.
Like different large electronics companies, Samsung faces challenges from the U.S.-China commerce warfare, falling costs of some reminiscence chips and the rise of low-cost Chinese language-made handsets. A journalist makes use of a cell phone as he works outdoors the Samsung Electronics smartphone manufacturing facility in Noida, India, July 9, 2018. REUTERS/Adnan Abidi
Samsung’s difficulties within the cell market, which accounts for about 40 % of its income, have been exacerbated by its latest lack of innovation to drive gross sales of its premium Galaxy collection devices. The cell enterprise booked 2.7 trillion received in quarterly working revenue.
Information launched by market tracker Counterpoint Analysis in July confirmed Samsung’s newest Galaxy 9 Plus premium handset had been overtaken by Apple’s iPhone eight because the world’s top-selling smartphone.
Competitors from cheaper Chinese language manufacturers like Xiaomi Corp ( 1810.HK ) and Huawei HWT.UL have already seen Samsung lose market share in China and India, the world’s prime smartphone markets.
Samsung regained its lead in India’s smartphone market within the second quarter due to stable gross sales in its finances section in response to Counterpoint Analysis.
Whereas the cell enterprise struggles, the chip enterprise remained Samsung’s prime earner within the second quarter as gross sales to the cloud-computing and crypto-currency industries propped up DRAM chip costs at the same time as NAND flash reminiscence costs slipped.
Samsung’s chip unit posted a report 11.6 trillion received working revenue, up 45 % from a yr in the past.
Samsung shares had been down zero.5 % in early buying and selling, in contrast with zero.2 % drop within the broader market .KS11 .
